digest.component_or_area: LLM plan-review signing and generation collection
propositions: sign-review deterministically fails with store-read-failure when untracked files exist in the shared tracker, blocking plan-review attestation and claims gate despite a passing plan review

resign.py:146 calls generation.collect without ignore_untracked parameter (defaults to False), causing strict git status check to include untracked files and emit store-read-failure on any unrelated tracked content
orchestrator.py:650 drift-refresh probe silently falls back to full multi-pass LLM re-review when untracked files exist due to swallowed exception, causing unnecessary cost and latency
attest.py has two fallback collect sites (lines 139 and 406) that suffer the same defect on the signing path
untracked files cannot change the committed head fingerprint, so ignore_untracked=True is safe and restores consistency with already-fixed generation.py authoritative under-lock re-check
